events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.93)
events.body:
This is a rider-side cancellation on an instant booking: the rider cancelled at 18:25:30, 2 min 30 s (150 s) after matching at 18:23:00 [F2]. NS-0 routes a rider cancellation to NS-4 [NS-0], and NS-4 makes the fee chargeable only when cancellation occurs more than 3 minutes after matching [NS-4]. The trace marks that element fail: 150 s ≤ 3:00, so the $6.61 cancellation fee is not chargeable and must be returned in full [F2][F5][NS-4].

The driver-side conditions never arose, so no alternative basis for the fee exists. The timeline records no driver_arrived_at [F3] and no arrival confirmation — driver_pressed_here_at is null, neither a driver tap nor a platform auto-arrival [F4]; accordingly none of the NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) elements can be met, and the fee also fails under NS-1/NS-2 [F4][NS-1]. Consistency check: GPS put the driver's closest approach to the pickup at 1816 m, never within 200 m [F1], which matches the absence of any arrival record [F3][F4] and contradicts nothing.

The driver's written statement that he "was on his way when the rider cancelled" [F10] is merely consistent with his own chat message of "5 min more" [F8]; it supplies no basis to charge the rider, since a rider's cancellation inside the 3-minute window is free regardless of driver ETA, and Ryde publishes no late-ETA waiver rule in reverse [F8][F10][NS-4]. Traffic was slow (JURONG EAST AVENUE 1, band 4) with no incidents on the route [F11][F12] — that explains the delay but does not revive a fee that NS-4 does not allow [F11][NS-4]. Profile facts (clean history both sides, 0 upheld disputes) do not decide anything here [F14][F15][NS-4].

Because the record contains no arrival confirmation at all, no flag_account arises: the abortive-arrival-tap abuse contemplated by NS-2 (tap "I'm Here" while outside the pickup radius) cannot be found where no tap was recorded [F4][F3][NS-2]. The 30-day dispute window is plainly met (fee in this trip's record) and the refund is issued as a voucher per NS-7 [F2][F5][NS-7]. The trace's allowed outcomes (refund_full / escalate) and amount ($6.61) are respected.

Safety screen: I read the complaint, both chat messages and the driver statement — no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the exchange is a routine ETA question and answer ("How long will you be?" / "5 min more, traffic is slow") [F7][F8][F10].
